name: Core AI vocabulary
summary: Sector-independent vocabulary for finding AI-related passages in corporate filings: what AI is called, how it is built, run, governed and misused, and what it does to work and markets. Tier 'ai' terms make a passage a candidate on their own; tier 'context' terms only signal that AI is likely discussed nearby. Sector-specific lingo lives in the per-ISIC-division glossaries.
